pages.text: Command a hundred souls through the Ten Thousand Soul Banner. This skill revolves around summoning, recalling, and harvesting souls from the banner.

$(bold)Type:$() Extra Skill$(br)$(bold)Obtainment:$() Cannot be unlocked automatically through EP; it must be obtained by other means$(br)$(bold)Modes:$() Summon Mode / Soul Collection Mode$(br2)Summon Mode costs 100000 magicules, summons or recalls your banner, and has a 40-minute cooldown. Soul Collection Mode costs 50000 magicules and converts souls in your owned or targeted banner into soul points; on success, it has a 20-minute cooldown.
